description: Stateless NACL for the public subnet 10.20.4.0/24 (load balancer). Lowest rule number first; first match wins; anything unmatched is denied. Clients use ephemeral ports 1024-65535.

inbound.comment: known abusive range: blocked on every port, numbered below the web allows so it wins
SSH only from the management subnet
replies from the app subnet (its port 8000) to the load balancer's ephemeral ports

outbound.comment: load balancer -> app tier on TCP 8000
replies to clients (web clients anywhere, SSH clients in management) on their ephemeral ports
